rule_of_thumb: Use RS-485 transceiver between MCU UART and A/B lines
why_it_matters: UART logic levels are not directly RS-485 differential levels

rule_of_thumb: Use daisy-chain trunk and avoid star wiring
why_it_matters: Improves signal integrity and reduces reflections

rule_of_thumb: Use 120 ohm at each physical end only
Use fail-safe bias at one location if required
why_it_matters: Keeps bus in known idle state

rule_of_thumb: For half-duplex set DE/RE with GPIO
Match baud parity and stop bits on all nodes
Use CRC timeout retries and exception handling
why_it_matters: Improves communication robustness in field conditions
